title: dect_nr_tap: Add DECT NR+ TAP header dissector
description:
Add TAP header dissector for TAP Header placed before DECT-NR+ MAC layer.

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body: Where is this TAP header documented?
You probably want to update the references for "DN Sniffer" to DECT NR+ TAP?
The header still reference to DN Sniffer, both in filename and documentation.

changed this line in [version 9 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/24559/diffs?diff_id=1927178155&start_sha=902553f732a63f2f7b0389bfef41788dfa06b1f8#709d249d741bdc4e048e6b24efae76a824e8511b_3_0)
`302` is registered to a different link type: https://www.tcpdump.org/linktypes.html

```
	/*
	 * To repeat:
	 *
	 * If you need a new encapsulation type for pcap and pcapng files,
	 * do *N*O*T* use *ANY* of the values listed here!  I.e., do *NOT*
	 * add a new encapsulation type by changing an existing entry;
	 * leave the existing entries alone.
	 *
	 * Instead, send mail to tcpdump-workers@lists.tcpdump.org, asking
	 * for a new DLT_ value, and specifying the purpose of the new value.
	 * When you get the new DLT_ value, use that numerical value in
	 * the "linktype_value" field of "pcap_to_wtap_map[]".
	 */
```

Add TAP header dissector for TAP Header placed before DECT-NR+ MAC layer.
